transcript:
Interviewer: This intake belongs only to the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: Pella Dune is my name. Oren Dune is my spouse.
Caller: We have no children together or separately.
Caller: I currently live at 24 Example Crescent Sampletown.
Caller: Our marriage date was 2007-04-22 and our separation date was 2024-05-09.
Interviewer: What property request should the fictional draft record?
Caller: Sell our jointly owned bungalow and split the proceeds equally.
Caller: End our marriage. The bungalow statement is my proposal, not a promise of an outcome.
Interviewer: This demonstration does not decide what happens to the home.

assertions.value: Sell our jointly owned bungalow and split the proceeds equally
